mounts.provenance_note: REPAIR ROUND (2026-09-29): resized to the SAM-only load. Runtime fact verified by the coordinator: select_ready_vls_mount fires the first vls_sam mount with rounds and never reads target_domain, so every cell counted in a vls_sam mount is mechanically an air-defense interceptor at runtime -- the prior two-mount (32 fwd + 32 aft) abstraction overstated the SAM inventory by also counting YJ-18A/YJ-20/CY-5-Yu-8 cells as SAM rounds. This single mount now holds exactly the ship's sourced HHQ-9B load (32, csg-cn-052d-navalnews-202303, B, matching weapon_inventory's representative_load). Of the 64 total universal VLS cells (8 modules, 4 fwd + 4 aft, csg-cn-052d-navalnews-202303 B), 32 are this SAM mount and the remaining 32 are content-only (YJ-18A/YJ-20/CY-5-Yu-8). engagement_range_m/projectile_speed_mps carried from HHQ-9B's own sourced figures (ONI-2015-chart-derived ~80-90nm ceiling; Mach 4.2 HQ-9 baseline, csg-cn-hhq9-mitchell B), same values as before since 052D's SAM load is HHQ-9B-only and was already using HHQ-9B's own figures
H/PJ-45A 130mm per csg-cn-052d-navalnews-202303 (B); conflicts with the older catalog's H/PJ-38 designation (C). No public muzzle velocity/range; proxy from the Mk-45 MVP calibration pattern

H/PJ-12 30mm (first 8 ships H/PJ-11) per csg-cn-052d-navalnews-202303 (B); Naval News states the reverse batch order versus the older catalog's claim of early-PJ-12/later-1130-1730 fit. Batch-dependent, treated as a single generic gun-CIWS mount. Carried from the repo's 30mm CIWS MVP calibration

052D and 052DL are written as ONE record per authoring decision #5 (the task lists them together as 'Type 052D/052DL'), with 052DL's deltas (length, hangar, aft radar) documented in _real_world.variant_scope rather than instantiated as separate numeric fields, since no single field in this schema cleanly represents a length/hangar variant without a second record.

REPAIR ROUND (2026-09-29): the prior two-mount abstraction (32 fwd + 32 aft, mixed HHQ-9(B)/YJ-18/YJ-20/CY-5-Yu-8/CJ-10) has been replaced with a single hhq9b_vls_sam mount sized to the ship's real 32-round HHQ-9B SAM load. Runtime fact verified by the coordinator in the engine's weapon-release service: select_ready_vls_mount fires the first vls_sam mount with rounds and never reads target_domain, so the old two-mount split (a) overstated the SAM inventory (every cell in either mount was mechanically a SAM at runtime, including ASCM/ASBM/ASW-rocket cells) and (b) made the second-listed mount functionally unreachable in practice. Since 052D's entire SAM load is a single type (HHQ-9B), one mount suffices and trivially carries that missile's own sourced range/speed. YJ-18A/YJ-20/CY-5-Yu-8 (the other 32 of the 64 total universal VLS cells) remain content-only in weapon_inventory, unchanged.

Gun/CIWS designation conflicts (H/PJ-45A vs H/PJ-38; H/PJ-12/H/PJ-11 batch order) recorded verbatim per Naval News's explicit conflict-noting; this record treats them as single generic mounts rather than picking a designation.

YJ-20 ship-launched-from-052D is now A/B-tier confirmed (CCTV 2026-07-29, first official confirmation for this hull type per ISW), an upgrade from the earlier Type-055-only sourcing basis; documented in weapon_inventory accordingly.
